title: Design a Multi-Modal Content Moderation & Spam Filtering System

spark.summary: Design a scalable Multi-Modal Content Moderation & Spam Filtering platform handling 15K uploads/sec across text, images, and video with <200ms sync text checks and <5s async video verdicts.
spark.keyTakeaway: When inference latency or GPU memory limits bind throughput, split synchronous Pre-Filter ingestion from an async Kafka-backed GPU Worker Pool, backed by a Redis Reputation & Velocity store and a Policy Engine.
spark.byteSummary:
A social platform receiving 15,000 uploads per second cannot block video uploads synchronously for 10 seconds of GPU processing, yet it must stop known abuse and spam before content goes viral.

Uploads enter an Ingestion API that stages media in S3, runs a synchronous Pre-Filter (PhotoDNA + Aho-Corasick spam), and publishes to Kafka. A GPU Worker Pool extracts video keyframes and runs CLIP, Whisper, and LLM Guardrails.

The Policy Engine combines model scores with Redis user-reputation and posting-velocity counters to trigger Quarantine, Takedown, or Human-in-the-Loop Escalation.

learningJourney.title: End-to-End Ingestion & GPU Worker Topology

explanation.core: Media binaries upload directly to S3 Staging via pre-signed URLs while metadata enters the Ingestion API. Kafka streams events through the CPU Pre-Filter (PhotoDNA + Aho-Corasick) to the GPU Worker Pool, which writes scores to the Policy Engine backed by Redis Reputation.

decisionFramework.problem: How to implement Design a Multi-Modal Content Moderation & Spam Filtering System without hitting unbounded tail latency, state divergence, or operational fragility.
decisionFramework.naiveSolution: Use a single unpartitioned path with unbounded retries and synchronous global coordination.
decisionFramework.whyItFails: Global coordination serializes throughput under load, while unbounded retries amplify transient stalls into full outages.
decisionFramework.alternatives: Compare synchronous strict-consistency paths against bounded asynchronous replication, local caching, or partitioned ownership.
decisionFramework.decision: When inference latency or GPU memory limits bind throughput, split synchronous Pre-Filter ingestion from an async Kafka-backed GPU Worker Pool, backed by a Redis Reputation & Velocity store and a Policy Engine.
decisionFramework.tradeOffs: Gains predictable p99 latency and fault isolation in exchange for explicit bounding, observability, and slightly higher implementation complexity.

learningJourney.title: Viral Link-Spam & Coordinated Campaign Detection
learningJourney.purpose: Detect botnets posting slightly mutated spam across thousands of accounts.

explanation.foundation: Think of **Viral Link-Spam & Coordinated Campaign Detection** as the intuition layer for Design a Multi-Modal Content Moderation & Spam Filtering System: Detect botnets posting slightly mutated spam across thousands of accounts.
explanation.core: Spammers rotate domains via URL shorteners and tweak 2 words per post. A streaming Flink MinHash/LSH deduplicator clusters near-duplicate text and resolves final redirect URLs in a sandboxed fetcher, auto-quarantining entire bot campaigns in seconds.
explanation.deepDive: Under heavy load or partial failure, viral link-spam & coordinated campaign detection becomes a critical lever for predictable latency and correctness. learningJourney.codeExample:
def check_campaign_cluster(text_minhash, resolved_domain, cluster_cache):
    cluster_id = cluster_cache.find_similar(text_minhash, jaccard_thresh=0.8)
    count = cluster_cache.increment(cluster_id, resolved_domain)
    return 'CAMPAIGN_QUARANTINE' if count > 50 else 'ALLOW'

knowledgeChecks.question: Why should the Ingestion API stage uploaded videos in S3 and pass only the S3 URI through Kafka to the GPU Worker Pool?

options.text: Passing multi-megabyte video blobs through Kafka saturates broker memory, disk I/O, and network bandwidth
options.feedback: Correct! The Claim-Check pattern (S3 staging + Kafka URI) keeps Kafka fast and prevents broker stalls.

options.text: Kafka only supports ASCII text and cannot transport binary bytes
options.feedback: Kafka transports raw bytes, but it is optimized for small messages, not large video blobs.

options.text: S3 automatically runs Whisper ASR on uploaded videos
options.feedback: S3 is object storage; GPU workers run Whisper.

options.text: PhotoDNA only works on S3 buckets
options.feedback: PhotoDNA operates on image pixels regardless of storage.

knowledgeChecks.explanation: The Claim-Check pattern keeps Kafka lightweight while S3 handles durable large-object storage.

knowledgeChecks.question: How do you prevent a flood of low-reach spam uploads from delaying moderation of a viral live-stream?

options.text: Route live-streams, viral posts, and reported items to a dedicated Priority Kafka topic with 80% worker allocation
options.feedback: Correct! Priority-tiered Kafka topics and weighted dequeueing eliminate head-of-line blocking.

options.text: Increase the PhotoDNA Hamming distance threshold to 250
options.feedback: Setting Hamming threshold to 250 would match almost every image as a false positive.
Disabling reputation checks weakens spam defense.

options.text: Run video moderation synchronously inside the HTTP upload request
options.feedback: Synchronous video scanning would time out HTTP uploads.

knowledgeChecks.explanation: Priority-tiered Kafka queues isolate high-impact live/viral content from bulk upload spikes.

knowledgeChecks.question: A botnet posts 500 slightly reworded spam messages using different URL shorteners across 500 new accounts. Which component catches this?

options.text: SHA-256 exact match on the post body
options.feedback: Rewording a single character breaks SHA-256.

options.text: Flink MinHash LSH near-duplicate clustering paired with sandboxed URL unfurling
options.feedback: Correct! MinHash LSH clusters mutated text while URL unfurling exposes the shared destination domain.
Text-only spam posts have no video keyframes.
Manual review cannot keep up with 500-account botnet bursts.

knowledgeChecks.explanation: MinHash LSH + URL unfurling detects coordinated spam campaigns across accounts.
